# Home Server repository instructions

Before inspecting, editing, reviewing, or operating this repository, read and
follow the repository-root `AGENTS.md`. It is the authoritative repository-wide
agent guide.

Load the task-specific `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` selected by the routing table in
`AGENTS.md`, then read the operator manual it names. Reusable task briefs under
`prompts/` define required inputs, separate authorization for Git/live/
external/destructive actions, and the evidence expected at completion.

Do not duplicate or weaken those rules here. If instructions disagree, stop
and report the conflict using the precedence rules in `AGENTS.md`.
